body:
PR #10 is open for review (stacked on PR #9 `product/story-79`): https://github.com/joemooney/aida-host/pull/10

Implements STORY-80 / ADR-82 (amending ADR-30):
- `AIDA_CARGO_SLOTS_MAX` (default 4 when `slots >= 2`, else `slots + 1`) opens adaptive burst slots `slots .. slots_max - 1`.
- `burst_ok` gates burst slots on priority (`prio <= AIDA_CARGO_BURST_MAX_PRIO=5`, barring `low`/`verylow`/`lowest`), `MemAvailable >= AIDA_CARGO_BURST_MEM_MIN_GIB=8` GiB, `AIDA_CARGO_BURST_COOLDOWN_S=30` s cooldown via `$dir/burst.last`, and PSI io-full/cpu-some thresholds.
- `cargo ps --capacity` reports `"slots_max"` (`cfg_max` when burst-eligible, else `slots`).
- All 25 test sections pass (`ALL PASS`). Proceeding to `BUG-83` (worktree target reaper + seed/disk floors) in `/home/joe/ai/aida-host-wip` next.
subject: READY FOR REVIEW: aida-host PR #10 — STORY-80 adaptive burst slots
